Exact brightness matching to the R4 profile is therefore unproven.

R6 stage averages are higher for kernel, palette, and audio; sparse worst-frame timing lacks stage-correlated trace on the exact cachefix binary, so attribution of its p99 tail is not proven.

Any successor should first prove a source-backed correction or fix the profile comparability setup without changing frozen gates, then pass exact build/admission before future live action.
